stdout:
easy-call: H2 generate_series uses emulation for cast expressions but exposes the raw iteration counter as the result.

Single-issue group; no duplicates. At upstream main 715ff0b5ac153a5520b989c039eec36677f2ede9, H2GenerateSeriesFunction rendering and query transformation use needsEmulation(start/stop/step), while its return-type resolver only switches to iteration-value mapping for column references, ordinality or temporal results. Cast parameters therefore select x instead of start + step * (x - 1).

Two-way door: a narrow internal H2 mapping correction, with no schema or public API change. Align the return-type resolver with the existing emulation condition; reuse the existing helpers rather than adding abstractions. Preserve literal/direct-parameter fast paths and existing ordinality/temporal behavior.

Use GenerateSeriesTest for the first tracer bullet: cast min/max parameters 5 and 7 must return [5, 6, 7]. Prove the reported wrong values in Actions before changing production code, then make the smallest fix and re-run. Extend coverage for separately cast start, stop and positive/negative step, ordinary parameter controls and ordinality as relevant. Run focused neighboring H2 tests and formatChecks at the final head.

Jira is unresolved/unassigned and the reporter branch is only a reproducer; all-state upstream searches found no overlapping fix. No tests were executed during this read-only exploration. Actual RED/GREEN remains implementation work.
